newsitem.title: USA: CliniCorp to reorganize with Trident.
newsitem.headline: CliniCorp to reorganize with Trident.

text.p: CliniCorp Inc, operating under Chapter 11 bankruptcy, said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to reorganize with Trident Medical Concepts Inc.
The company said in a statement Trident would likely become controlling shareholder of the company. Trident is a health care corporation specializing in physician group management.
Trident and CliniCorp will design a plan of reorganization that will be subject to the approval of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court. CliniCorp filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June.

The company also said Lawrence Markson resigned as its chairman and chief executive. He "left the company to devote his full time and attention to Markson Management Services Inc," the statement said.
Haim Zitman will become president and chief operating officer. He succeeds Gerard Herlihy, who resigned in May.
The company also said it had signed a financing agreement with 1325 Associates L.L.C. and Capital Healthcare Financing, a division of Capital Factors Inc.
1325 will provide up to $300,000 to cover shortfalls that are not covered by the accounts receivable lending line with Capital. -- New York newsroom, (212) 859-1610
